svg.title: The Kanso System — an animated solar system of Mohamad Kanso’s projects
svg.desc: A blue-white star orbited by eight planets, one per project: VoiceSafeKit, CodeSentry, MurmurX, DreamSense, IncidentForge, WorkflowForge, the BTC LSTM dissertation and Trading ML research, plus the Hermes Agent comet.
